behavior: The pay page and the canary check the terms and the page text, and the api checks the factory on every enabled chain at startup
acceptance: R-45, R-51, D-71: before showing an address the pay page refuses amount 0, a settle deadline other than expiry + 24 h, expiry more than a year after creation and a recipient equal to zero, the token, the factory or the implementation; the canary refuses input terms that break create's rules and alerts when the pay page's amount panel does not name the token's symbol and the chain; the api refuses to start when the factory has no code on an enabled chain; a profile creates at most 500 invoices per day; unit and backend tests cover each; money-safety.md (incl. the canary query) and architecture.md match; the security review records are removed once their findings are fixed
notes: 2026-10-11 review fail by reviewer: Fail, one defect. apps/backend/internal/address/deployed.go:15 wraps the raw CodeAt error (%w) and cmd/api/main.go:27 logs it as 'api stopped' unredacted. go-ethereum puts the full RPC URL into network errors, and Infura URLs carry the key (/v3/<key>, internal/chain/chain.go:83). Reproduced with a fake key and a hanging RPC: 'chain 1: read the factory: Post "http://127.0.0.1:63554/v3/FAKEKEY123": context deadline exceeded'. This breaks AGENTS.md (never log keys) and chain.Redact's rule (chain.go:124-125, every logged RPC error); check.go:54 already redacts the eth_blockNumber failure in the same startup check. Fix: return chain.Redact(err) text (or redact in main) and add a test case. Everything else checked: pay-page rules match create (SettleWindow, MaxExpiresIn, recipient set in buildTerms invoice.go:213); amount panel names symbol and chain for all 4 testnets plus Anvil (TokenMark + PAY_TOKENS vs migrations 00015-00017); canary SQL joins tokens (chain_id, contract) PK and chains, column order matches parseTerms; gate test deploys the factory before the api, load test enables its chain after api start; MaxPerDay comment matches watcher.go:251; no link to docs/reviews left, check-docs 0 errors; vitest pay 13 passed, go test canary/address/invoice ok, lint clean; verify logs 16:42:56Z postdate all edits.

2026-10-11 review pass by reviewer: Pass on re-review. The earlier key leak is fixed at the shared point: internal/chain/check.go:58-60 returns errors.New(Redact(err)) for every further startup check, so neither the api factory check (address/deployed.go) nor the signer gas check can log an Infura /v3/ key; new subtest check_test.go 'a further check's error has no key' fails without it, and no cmd caller uses errors.Is/As on the result. Pay page allows 300 s of clock skew on the one-year rule (receive-address.ts CLOCK_SKEW_S), closing the API-vs-DB clock edge. Canary malformed-input test now covers a zero recipient and recipient == token. Earlier checks still hold: pay-page rules match create, amount panel names symbol and chain on all 4 testnets plus Anvil, canary SQL and column order correct, startup check breaks no deploy or test path, MaxPerDay docs accurate, check-docs 0 errors. Reran go test chain/canary/address/invoice ok, vitest pay 13 passed; verify logs 16:55:29Z postdate all edits and pass (unit, backend, e2e 31+20, lint, typecheck, build, docs, harness). Non-blocking: no migration seeds the Base Sepolia chains row, and the canary needs its name to be base-sepolia; the amount-panel symbol/network match is a substring check.

proof.1: backend: address TestFactoryDeployed used by the api's startup check, and chain TestCheckEnabled shows a further check's error is logged without an Infura key (also covers the signer's gas check); canary TestCheck 'page names another network' and TestCheckRejectsMalformedInput (amount 0, wrong deadline, zero or token recipient); invoice TestInvoicesPerProfilePerDayAreCapped; unit: receive-address.test.ts refuses terms the API would never create even when they compute to the address, with 5 minutes of clock tolerance on the one-year expiry; e2e: pay.spec checks the canary script reads the amount panel naming USDC on Base Sepolia, and the live suites pass; money-safety.md (canary query), architecture.md and api.md match; docs/reviews removed
